title: 第10章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 竟然是他众人的视线都聚集在她的身上，司绵轻咳了一下，再次小声嘀咕，“我不嫁人，而且我又不认识什么鬼总裁”苏建豪自然也是希望他能改变主意的，试探性的开口，“顾贤侄，这就是绵绵，要不，你再考虑考虑”司绵顺着苏建豪的视线望过去，才发现坐在那儿的内敛男子，当看清楚样子时，心都提到了嗓子眼，手心冒汗。他怎么在这里？要是被妈知道她醉后献身，还跟陌生人发生了关系，非把她的皮给剥了不可。顾墨的目光越过众人，落在司绵的身上，再次重复，“不用考虑了，我就娶她”他要娶自己？司绵瞪大了眼睛，他是总裁？天啦，她竟然把总裁大人给扑倒了。“绵绵，过去叫人”刘紫兰推推她。司绵踌躇了一下，不太情愿的走过去，站在顾墨的面前，瞥见苏建豪在旁边盯着自己，司绵立刻扬起一抹灿烂极致的微笑，声音甜美，“顾伯伯好”顾墨刚毅的眉头一挑，连伯伯都出来了，亏她叫得出口。苏建豪连忙开口，“绵绵，顾总裁年轻有为，才二十九岁就成为了本市的总裁，什么伯伯啊”随即又向顾墨干笑的解释，“顾贤侄千万别往心里去，绵绵还小，不懂事”顾墨不吭声，扫视了她一眼。她穿着一件样式简单的衬衣，下身一条紧身的牛仔裤，身形看起来很单薄，低着头站在那儿。“爸，我还没有结婚的打算”司绵畏畏缩缩的开口。苏建豪立刻呵斥到，“顾贤侄愿意娶你，是你的福气，你那有拒绝的道理”司绵脖子缩了一下，实际上在心里狂骂顾墨，靠，那条法律规定，他想娶，她就必须要嫁啊。顶他个肺啊。顾墨蓦地站起来，身形很高大，健美，司绵站在他的面前，跟小矮人一样。他浑身充斥着威严，司绵下意识的后退一步，他俯身靠在她的耳畔，用他们两个听得见的声音说，“如果我去报警，说你那天闯进我的房间想要经行不正当的交易，你说你要坐多少年牢？所以嫁不嫁你考虑清楚再说”司绵偏头看着他，眼里有着不敢置信，“我会上诉的”这老男人竟然连这种无耻的话都说得出口。“以我的身份和地位，你认为别人是相信你的话还是我的，而且你认为我会给你上诉的机会吗？”说完，他便往外面走去，已经不想再继续留下来了。顾家世代都出政客，推算到明朝那也是官宦之家，别说南华市了，就是在全中国，那怕是全亚洲，那也是响当当的家族，权利和地位，顾家从来不缺。所以能谁能跟顾家攀上关系，那以后必定是一人得道，鸡犬升天的。虽说司绵也叫自己一声爸，但毕竟不是亲生的，怎么顾墨就偏偏看上她了呢，而且顾老爷明明很中意心心的。能和这么优秀的男人有交集，苏心不抗拒，要是没被选上，她也不失落，说实话，她也还年轻，也没做好结婚的准备，而且她才不想为材米油盐酱醋茶操心呢。苏心朝司绵笑了笑，“绵绵，未来的总裁夫人哟，以后还请多多关照”“姐，你就别调侃我了”司绵一点也不想嫁，看着刘紫兰说，“妈，他眼睛是不是有问题啊，他怎么就看上我了呢，要不，明天我介绍一个眼科专家给他看看”一想到那晚他们发生的事情，再想着以后要嫁给他，司绵就心里慎得慌。总觉得他们两个要是真结婚了，那个婚后的场面，她都不敢想象，鸡飞狗跳都算是小意思了。“别乱说，这还踩在人家的地盘上呢”刘紫兰提醒她。
content_en: It turned out that everyone's attention was focused on him. Si Mian coughed lightly and whispered again, "I'm not getting married, and I don't know any ghost CEO." Su Jianhao naturally hoped that he could change his mind, tentatively Si Mian said, "Nephew Gu Xian, this is Mian Mian. Otherwise, you can think about it again." Si Mian followed Su Jianhao's gaze and found the reserved man sitting there. When he saw his appearance clearly, his heart was in his throat and his palms were sweating. Why is he here? If her mother found out that she had given herself up while drunk and had sex with a stranger, her skin would have to be peeled off. Gu Mo's eyes crossed the crowd and landed on Si Mian. He repeated again, "No need to think about it, I will marry her." Does he want to marry himself? Si Mian's eyes widened. He was the CEO? Oh my God, she actually knocked down the CEO. "Mianmian, go over and call someone." Liu Zilan pushed her. Si Mian hesitated for a moment, then reluctantly walked over and stood in front of Gu Mo. Seeing Su Jianhao staring at her from the side, Si Mian immediately raised a brilliant smile and said in a sweet voice, "Hello, Uncle Gu." Gu Mo raised his brow resolutely. Even his uncle came out, but she was able to shout. Su Jianhao said quickly, "Mianmian, President Gu is young and promising. He became the president of this city at the age of twenty-nine. What kind of uncle are you?" Then he explained to Gu Mo with a dry smile, "Nephew Gu Xian, please don't take it seriously. Mianmian is still young and ignorant." Gu Mo said nothing and glanced at her. She was wearing a simple shirt and a pair of tight jeans. She looked very thin and stood there with her head lowered. "Dad, I have no plans to get married yet," Si Mian said timidly. Su Jianhao immediately scolded, "You are lucky that Nephew Gu Xian is willing to marry you. You have no reason to refuse." Si Mian flinched and actually cursed Gu Mo in his heart. Damn, that law stipulates that if he wants to marry, she must marry him. Go to his lungs. Gu Mo stood up suddenly. He was tall and fit. Si Mian stood in front of him like a dwarf. His whole body was full of majesty, and Si Mian subconsciously took a step back. He leaned over her ear and said in a voice that was audible to both of them, "If I go to the police and say that you broke into my room that day and wanted to do unfair transactions, how many years do you think you will have to go to jail? So you should think carefully about whether to marry or not." Si Mian tilted her head and looked at him with disbelief in her eyes, "I will appeal." This old man could even say such shameless words. "With my identity and status, do you think others believe your words or mine, and do you think I will give you a chance to appeal?" After saying that, he walked outside, no longer wanting to stay any longer. The Gu family has produced politicians for generations, and it is estimated that it was also a family of officials in the Ming Dynasty. Not to mention Nanhua City, it was a well-known family in the whole of China, even in Asia. The Gu family has never lacked power and status. Therefore, whoever can establish a relationship with the Gu family will definitely achieve enlightenment in the future, and the chickens and dogs will ascend to heaven. Although Si Mian also called him daddy, she was not her biological child after all. Why did Gu Mo fall in love with her, and Master Gu obviously liked her very much. Su Xin didn't resist being able to meet such an outstanding man, and she wouldn't be disappointed if she wasn't chosen. To be honest, she was still young and not ready for marriage, and she didn't want to worry about food, rice, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar and tea. Su Xin smiled at Si Mian, "Mianmian, future wife of the CEO, please take good care of me in the future." "Sister, please stop teasing me." Si Mian didn't want to marry at all. She looked at Liu Zilan and said, "Mom, is there something wrong with his eyes? Why did he fall in love with me? Otherwise, I will introduce an ophthalmologist to him tomorrow." Thinking of what happened to them that night and thinking about marrying him in the future, Si Mian felt panicked. She always felt that if the two of them really got married, she couldn't even imagine the post-marriage scene, and it would be a trivial matter. "Don't talk nonsense, you are stepping on someone else's territory," Liu Zilan reminded her.
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
